rafael_pm: Quick sync — we need to finalize the model discovery / capability flags shape for API docs and the discovery endpoint. Proposal below, please reply with any hard blockers or missing fields.

rafael_pm: Proposal (response body example):
```json
{
  "model_id": "gpt-redwood-1",
  "capabilities": {
    "chat": true,
    "completions": true,
    "embeddings": false,
    "rerank": true,
    "tools": ["browser", "calculator"],
    "streaming": true,
    "streaming_modes": ["text_chunk", "event"],
    "max_context_tokens": 8192,
    "max_response_tokens": 4096,
    "structured_output": {
      "json_schema": true,
      "strict_mode": false
    
    }
  }
}
```

alex_eng: +1 on single endpoint. Two small asks: expose `token_resolution` semantics (how kv-cache + prompt + reply add up) and make `max_*_tokens` explicitly documented as best-effort for hosted vs dedicated.

maya_ml: For model variants note: quantized variants may change `max_response_tokens` because we drop KV caching threshold. Also add `precision` (fp16/int8) and `kv_cache_behavior` (evict_policy) if possible — helps optimizer recommend fallbacks.

chris_devex: SDK concern: need consistent field names across languages. Suggest canonical fields: `supports.{chat,completions,embeddings,rerank,tools,streaming,structured_output}` and `limits.{context_tokens,response_tokens}`. Also add `supported_tool_calls` array with tool metadata (name, version, schema_url).

rafael_pm: Good points. Updated minimal public surface to propose: `supports` booleans, `supported_tool_calls` list (name + id + optional schema url), `streaming_modes`, `limits` with `context` + `response` + optional `note` (range or best-effort). Keep `precision` private for now but surface `quantized=true/false`.

sophia_legal: Heads-up: exposing exact numeric hard limits to public docs can create SLO mismatch risk. Recommend `limits` support either exact number OR `{min,max}` range plus `stability: high|medium|low`. That lets us avoid promising hard SLAs in docs.

alex_eng: Agree with ranges + stability. For streaming, we should clarify whether `max_response_tokens` applies per-stream chunk or overall. My vote: overall. Document chunk size under `streaming_modes` descriptions.

chris_devex: One more: include `sample_request_url` and `sample_response_snippet` for each capability so docs and SDKs can auto-generate examples.

rafael_pm: Action items: (1) I'll open a spec PR with the proposed JSON shape + examples for hosted/dedicated/private by EOD tomorrow. (2) @alex_eng and @maya_ml please add sections on token accounting and quantized variants. (3) @chris_devex add SDK mapping table in the PR. (4) @sophia_legal review public-limits wording.

deploy-bot: Deploy check: spec PR template created — PR #4123 placeholder. :robot_face:

maya_ml: minor note — add `supports.multistream_sessions` for models that allow parallel cached sessions (useful for conversation multiplexing).

rafael_pm: Noted. I'll include `supports.multistream_sessions` as optional. If there are no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll merge the spec and start docs work.

alex_eng: No objections from infra side.

sophia_legal: Will review wording tomorrow morning.

chris_devex: I'll stub SDK changes after the PR lands.

rafael_pm: Thanks all. Short and actionable — will follow up in the PR thread. :thumbsup:
